name: id-linkcite
description: Serves https://id.linkcite.org: each IRI resolves to its public description, from a read-only Oxigraph store, through Trifid

scripts.build: npm run build:sources && npm run build:site
scripts.test: .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests && node --check trifid/plugins/pages.js && node --check trifid/plugins/redirects.js && node --check editorial_service/admin.js
